label: short_factual
prompt: What is the capital of France?
text: The capital of France is Paris.

label: longer_explanation
prompt: Explain in a few sentences why retrieval-augmented generation is useful.
text: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is useful because it bridges the gap between a language model’s static training data and real-time, domain-specific information. By fetching relevant external documents and feeding them into the model alongside the prompt, RAG drastically reduces "hallucinations" (made-up facts), ensures answers are up-to-date, and allows AI systems to securely cite proprietary or private data without needing costly retraining.
